scheme: NCDC allocates Weeks 10–12 to The Call. This ten-week term supports only the beginning and first recipients of the Prophet's call. Public preaching, reactions and problems faced need additional sourced periods.
The final period is reserved for end-of-term assessment. The full questions, answers and marking guide must be selected from the resource pack when the lesson is written.
Ledgerly reserves the third period each week for revision. No unsupported review questions are invented here.

reviewerNotes: Source-based 20-lesson outline across six NCDC subthemes. Each citation checked against the passages in the official P3 curriculum and teachers' resource book.
